items.t: There is no rapid transit in Chilliwack: no SkyTrain, West Coast Express or SeaBus station is in the city. Route 66 Fraser Valley Express (BC Transit) runs Downtown Chilliwack to Lougheed Town Centre Station, the nearest rapid-transit station.
Nearest bus exchange: Downtown Exchange, Chilliwack.
Route 57 Broadway (BC Transit): Downtown Chilliwack to Cottonwood Mall via Yale Rd at Menzies St and Young Rd.
Route 51 Vedder (BC Transit): Downtown Chilliwack to UFV Chilliwack via Yale Rd at Menzies St and Vedder Rd.

faq.q: How is transit changing in this part of Chilliwack?
faq.a: BC Transit's service changes effective January 4, 2026 moved Route 57 Broadway's Carleton Street service one block east to McNaught Road with new stops on McNaught and Acorn, added Sunday-evening service on Routes 51, 53 Fairfield and 57 Broadway, and expanded weekend trips on Route 66 Fraser Valley Express, which serves Chilliwack, Abbotsford, Langley and Burnaby daily.
